headword: {世界一周|せかいいっしゅう}
gloss: round-the-world trip; trip around the world

definitions.explanation: A journey that goes all the way around the world, returning to the starting point. Used of travel by ship, plane, or any means.

examples.japanese: {世界一周|せかいいっしゅう}が{夢|ゆめ}だ。
examples.english: A round-the-world trip is my dream.

examples.japanese: {船|ふね}で{世界一周|せかいいっしゅう}をした。
examples.english: I traveled around the world by ship.

examples.japanese: お{金|かね}と{時間|じかん}をためて、いつか{世界一周|せかいいっしゅう}の{旅|たび}に{出|で}たい。
examples.english: I want to save up money and time and someday set off on a trip around the world.

notes:
{世界|せかい} (world) + {一周|いっしゅう} (one lap, one circuit). Takes する: {世界一周|せかいいっしゅう}をする / {世界一周|せかいいっしゅう}する.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世界一周|せかいいっしゅう}の{旅|たび}: a round-the-world journey
- {世界一周|せかいいっしゅう}をする: to travel around the world
- {世界一周|せかいいっしゅう}クルーズ: a round-the-world cruise

RELATED:
{一周|いっしゅう} (one circuit) is the same counter used in {日本一周|にほんいっしゅう} (a trip around Japan).
